title: Steam
summary: GodotSteam lobbies (create/join/overlay invites) with SteamMultiplayerPeer handed to Network.adopt_peer; ENet stays the fallback; works (and tests green) without GodotSteam installed
claude_md: - Steam goes through `SteamService` (feature-detected GodotSteam, test app id 480); keep every network feature working over ENet too (tests run on ENet).
